title: Zebrafish body proportions vs size
not_a_mechanistic_model: Measured regressions and photograph-based proportions; no mechanism.

slope.locator: Results: "The slope and intercept of the linear model between the mass logarithm and the length logarithm were 3.22 with a 95% confidence interval of (2.97; 3.46) and -5.24 with a 95% confidence interval of (-5.83; -4.65)"

intercept.locator: same sentence; parameter table gives the refit W_a 3.205, W_b -5.193

mass_vs_length.data: 60 juveniles, 10-50 dpf, "from the hatching length to near 15 mm", SL to 0.1 mm and wet mass to 0.1 mg; AB strain, 27.1 +/- 2.0 C
mass_vs_length.log_base: not stated in the paper; natural log inferred from units: ln gives 8.8 mg at 10 mm and about 0.5 g at 35 mm SL (plausible), log10 would give micrograms (impossible). Flagged as an inference.
mass_vs_length.caveat: fitted on fish up to ~15 mm; applied to adults by extrapolation (b not different from 3, per the authors)

fishbase_row_not_used.locator: Length-weight list; b exactly 3 with n 3 and no locality looks like an estimate, not a fitted study

body_proportions_vs_SL.locator: Table 3, "Prediction of SL and HAA from other quantitative measures"

relations.quantity: height at anterior of anal fin (HAA)

adult_proportions_from_photos.kind: secondary (measured on two photographs by FishBase)

pectoral_fin_length.note: No numeric pectoral fin length/SL for wild-type zebrafish was found in fetched text. Daane et al. 2018 measured pectoral fin length normalised to SL with calipers on fish > 3 months old, but the values appear only in Fig. 1A. FishBase morphometrics give no pectoral length. trajectory.mjs therefore returns finLength_SL = null for zebrafish rather than inventing one.

pectoral_fin_form_by_size.value: larval fin: endoskeletal disc + fin fold, no rays; disc from 4 dpf, persisting through the second week
pectoral_fin_form_by_size.locator: "By 4 days post-fertilization, an endochondral disc has formed ... persists through the second week of development"

pectoral_fin_form_by_size.unit: mm SL: initial stages of anterior-most lepidotrichia formation; disc cartilage decomposition starting between proximal radials 2 and 3
pectoral_fin_form_by_size.locator: Fig. 8 legend, control larvae at 6.4 mm SL (facility 28 C)

pectoral_fin_form_by_size.unit: mm SL: numbered pectoral rays visible, distinct interray zones, no calcification yet
